      -vv \

      --durations=10 \
      --maxfail=3
    ```
  - For the tool tests (inside `lib/crewai-tools`):
    ```
    cd lib/crewai-tools && uv run pytest \
      -vv \
      --splits 8 \
      --group <group_number> \
      --durations=10 \
      --maxfail=3

  - The duration cache argument `--durations-path=...` is currently disabled to avoid test duplication issues. When enabled, it is passed as `--durations-path=<duration_file>`.
- Environment details:

  - OS for tests: ubuntu-latest
- Additional flags explained:
  - `-vv`: verbose pytest output
  - `--splits 8`: splits tests into 8 groups for parallel execution
  - `--group <num>`: runs the numbered group of tests
  - `--durations=10`: shows top 10 slowest test durations
  - `--maxfail=3`: stops after 3 test failures
